question: Which of the following is NOT one of the main pillars of the ‘Namami Gange Programme’, launched by the Government of India in 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**River Linkage Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **River Linkage Development** is NOT one of the main pillars of the '**Namami Gange Programme**'.
 
• The main pillars of the 'Namami Gange Programme' include **Industrial Effluent Monitoring, River-Front Development, and Sewerage Treatment Infrastructure**.
